Package org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.dcat.properties

Class DcatDistribution

java.lang.Object
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.dcat.properties.DcatDistribution
public class DcatDistribution extends Object
DcatDistribution describes a specific representation of a dataset (dcat:Distribution) such as a downloadable file or an access point.
